text:
$1.77 EPS Expected for NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NXPI) Posted by Clifton Ray 15 pm
Analysts expect NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) to report $1.77 EPS on February, 6.They anticipate $1.29 EPS change or 42.16 % from last quarter’s $3.06 EPS. NXPI’s profit would be $523.03M giving it 11.29 P/E if the $1.77 EPS is correct. After having $1.81 EPS previously, NXP Semiconductors N.V.’s analysts see -2.21 % EPS growth. The stock increased 4.58% or $3.5 during the last trading session, reaching $79.94. About 5.79 million shares traded or 15.79% up from the average. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has declined 33.99% since January 10, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.99% the S&P500. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) Ratings Coverage
Among 16 analysts covering NXP Semiconductors ( NASDAQ:NXPI ), 10 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 63% are positive. NXP Semiconductors had 20 analyst reports since July 26, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. The rating was downgraded by Stifel Nicolaus to “Sell” on Wednesday, September 12. The company was upgraded on Friday, July 27 by SunTrust. The company was upgraded on Friday, July 27 by Mizuho. The stock has “Neutral” rating by Citigroup on Friday, November 2. The stock has “Buy” rating by Bank of America on Monday, September 17. The firm has “Buy” rating by Deutsche Bank given on Friday, July 27. The stock of NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) earned “Hold” rating by Stifel Nicolaus on Friday, July 27. Morgan Stanley maintained it with “Equal-Weight” rating and $100 target in Wednesday, October 3 report. The stock of NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) earned “Buy” rating by Goldman Sachs on Thursday, October 18. As per Friday, November 2, the company rating was maintained by BMO Capital Markets.
NXP Semiconductors N.V., a semiconductor company, provides high performance mixed signal and standard product solutions for radio frequency , analog, power management, interface, security, and digital processing products worldwide. The company has market cap of $23.62 billion. It offers products for audio and visual head-end unit applications, such as single-chip radio solutions, audio amplifiers and power analog products, and i.MX applications processors; and in-vehicle networking products, two-way secure entry products, and various sensors and microcontrollers, as well as power management solutions. It has a 10.17 P/E ratio. The firm also provides secure identification solutions comprising passive RF connectivity devices; microcontroller devices; and secure real-time operating system software products to facilitate the encryption-decryption of data, and the interaction with the reader infrastructure systems.
